title: An integral degree-three Gersten counterexample

abstractEnglish: We construct a two-dimensional ramified regular local ring A in mixed characteristic $`(0,5)`$ for which the integral map $`K_3(A)\to K_3(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ has nonzero kernel. This gives a negative answer to the unrestricted integral Gersten conjecture.

details.overview: 稿件在混合特征(0,5)下构造了一个二维分歧正则局部环A，使得整系数映射K_3(A)→K_3(Frac A)的核非零。作者据此对无限制的整系数Gersten猜想给出否定回答。研究对象是代数K理论中Gersten猜想的整系数版本，结果说明该猜想在二维分歧正则局部环、混合特征情形下不成立，对理解K理论局部—整体性质有参考意义。
